title: Sample planning policy
body:
Hi Sam,

SIMULATED DEVELOPMENT DATA — fictional companies and commitments.

Robot X and Robot Y require MC-100 R2. All donor-plant production commitments must remain feasible. At the disrupted plant, minimize unfilled finished units in priority tier 1, then tier 2, then incremental recovery cost. Do not double-count BOM demand as daily consumption. Existing POs are not cancelled when recovery supply is purchased. Unfulfilled production remains backlog; do not silently reschedule it. Show order value exposed, not guaranteed revenue saved.

Best,
Jordan Ellis
Operations Director
Fictional Atlas Robotics — Operations
jordan.ellis@atlas-robotics.example
subject: Sample planning policy
